purpose: Controlled identical-input comparison of the current One-Box pipeline (Path A) and direct Refero research handoff (Path B).

paths.label: Direct Refero MCP research workflow
paths.variable: direct Refero research and synthesis handoff

constants: copy facts, imagery policy, viewport checks, and quality gates

liveExecution.reason: The harness never authenticates, reads credentials, invokes Refero, invokes OpenRouter, or spends money. A separately approved live runner must record provenance before this harness will present or unblind results.

humanGate.rule: A named human evaluator must submit complete blind scores with evidence for every rubric area before unblinding.

blinding.presentationRule: Presentation copies exclude provenance.json. Producer/model/provider, path identity, timing, and cost metadata must remain in coordinator-only provenance, not the evaluator-facing artifact content.
